en: Black‑and‑white view of a riverside European town. In the foreground a wide river flows past; small wooden boats are pulled up near the stony shore. A large side‑wheel steamship crowded with passengers moves along the river, emitting a tall plume of dark smoke. On the opposite bank stand a line of houses against a high stone embankment wall with arches. Above them, on a wooded hill, is a vast multi‑winged palace or castle complex. To the right, in the town, rises a large church with a tall tower and steep roof, plus additional spires in the distance. The scene has an early‑20th‑century feel and resembles a typical central‑European historic riverside city.
